entries.1a4df0bbd33dc2ed: After rights adjustment, properties are sold to real estate companies, business companies and individuals through real estate brokers. entries.2793d6d0e9638c50: Revenue expanded from ¥16,836 million for the fiscal year ended December 2021 to ¥23,269 million for the fiscal year ended December 2023, passed through ¥25,620 million for the fiscal year ended December 2024, and was ¥23,348 million for the fiscal year ended December 2025. Sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were centered on sokochi at ¥11,642 million, with idenuki at ¥8,700 million and freehold properties at ¥2,402 million, and the decline in idenuki sales is printed as the cause of the revenue decrease. It has 190 employees and sales offices at 7 locations nationwide.

entries.5f855153fdf8b11d: A real estate company whose main business is adjusting rights relationships in properties such as leased land (sokochi) subject to the old law, then increasing their value and selling them.
entries.69cf7d0fda76b308: It is the group's only reportable segment.
entries.6ba6c3483831fbee: Sales destinations are real estate companies, business companies and individuals.
entries.6c6a6e8e3d0dddec: Management services for sokochi under “Owners Partner” (agency for collection of ground rent and procedures for renewal of land lease contracts, etc.)
entries.6c6d8934abc2ec86: This is the group's only reportable segment. Mainly for land beneath leased buildings subject to the former Land Lease Act and former House Lease Act, the company purchases properties from landowners, raises their real estate value through rights adjustment, and then sells them. The company and two consolidated subsidiaries (Sansei Landic Funding Co., Ltd., which undertakes fund formation work for the company's business, and Hachimantai Kanko Kassei Godo Kaisha, which was established to operate accommodation facilities) conduct this business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥23,348 million.
entries.6cd1083b99283f1b: Since 1991, it has handled sokochi, which general real estate companies have seldom treated as transaction targets, and for sokochi to which the former laws apply, it has methods of rights adjustment, including confirming boundaries with adjoining land, subdividing by leasehold lot, and negotiating with leaseholders. For idenuki, it conducts eviction negotiations with tenancy rights holders, including requests to vacate, introduction of relocation destinations and bearing of relocation costs. Until sale, it earns ground rent and also undertakes management work for landowners through “Owners Partner,” which handles ground rent collection and contract renewal procedures.
entries.7005e07353e60111: The company purchases land and buildings held under full freehold ownership from their owners and sells them to real estate companies, business companies and individuals through real estate brokers. Sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were 11 cases and ¥2,402 million.

entries.7a9fb925a4d841a0: It purchases from landowners mainly sokochi to which the former Land Lease Act and former House Lease Act apply, idenuki properties (aged land and buildings subject to tenancy rights), and freehold properties, and raises the value of real estate through rights adjustment, such as negotiations with leaseholders and negotiations with tenants for eviction, to make them fully owned. In addition, it operates “Owners Partner,” which takes on comprehensive management of sokochi, and operates rental real estate.
entries.7e6825efbc22b70b: Revenue consists of ground rent and rental income, brokerage fee income, commissioned service fee income, etc. It includes “Owners Partner,” which contracts for the comprehensive management of leased land (collection of ground rent, follow-up on overdue payments, procedures for renewing land lease terms, etc.), and rental income from rental properties such as office buildings, condominiums and apartments. Sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥602 million.

entries.845051c9bd3b2871: The company purchases land subject to leasehold rights from the landowner, carries out rights adjustments such as fixing boundaries with adjacent land, subdividing the land by leasehold parcel and negotiating with leaseholders, and sells the land after it becomes fully owned, either through sales to leaseholders that give them full ownership or through purchase of the leasehold rights by the company.
entries.9dc8b742a2775b66: Purchase and sale of freehold properties

entries.aeaf5039d5e57320: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥23,348 million, down 8.9% year on year. The decrease is printed as being due to a decline in idenuki sales, although sales of sokochi and freehold properties increased.
entries.b550ded7db15df9a: It is advancing a medium-term management plan (August 2024 to December 2027) and positions the fiscal year ended December 2026, its second year, as a “Year of Execution.” In its existing sokochi and idenuki business, it will continue to upgrade schemes to strengthen procurement, and will expand high value-added menus centered on rights adjustment and improve business operating efficiency. At the same time, it will advance verification toward scaling derivative businesses such as co-ownership interests and fixed-term holdings, and build the foundation for its regional revitalization promotion business, and it states that it will steadily execute its financial and non-financial strategies.

entries.e0a78b18ad1db344: The reportable segment consists solely of the real estate sales business, and there is no revenue from external customers outside Japan. In the information on major customers, Samty Co., Ltd. and Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. are shown as major customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025. Its main business is handling sokuchi (land subject to leasehold under the old law) and ijinuki (properties sold with existing fixtures), and it operates from its head office in Tokyo and branches in Sapporo, Sendai, Nagoya, Kyoto, Kansai and Kyushu.

entries.e4a8800f6fa1421b: The company purchases land subject to leasehold rights from the landowner, carries out rights adjustments such as fixing boundaries with adjacent land, subdividing the land by leasehold parcel and negotiating with leaseholders, and sells the land after it becomes fully owned, either through sales to leaseholders that give them full ownership or through purchase of the leasehold rights by the company. During the period until sale, the company receives ground rent from leaseholders. Sales results for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were 298 cases and ¥11,642 million.
entries.f37f8515fa3c5385: Sansei Landic Co.,Ltd was established in February 1976 as Sansei Sābisu Co., Ltd. in Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo, and its head office is in Marunouchi, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo.
